name: An-an Lee
bio: Archetype: Empwer Incantation, DMG Buff. ⌽ Stance swaps each round (Tank↔Damage) ⌽ Rightmost card ranks up when entering Damage Stance and using Ultimate grants [Empower Incantation I] for 2 rounds. ⌽ Deals decent damage with some CC due to frequent access of high-tier Skill 1. ⌽ Skill 2 grants allies DMG Bonus and DMG taken reduction (like Sonetto's buff).
